title: Exit after a one-shot subcommand instead of hanging under bun --watch. bun run dev auth completes its work, prints the token path, then hangs until the user presses Ctrl-C. A differential probe shows the same failure for debug: bun run start -- debug exits code 0 in 976ms while bun run dev debug hangs, with identical output, so the command logic is fine and Bun's watcher is holding the process. check-usage shares the shape, so all three one-shot subcommands are affected while start was already fixed for SIGINT in c9e35aa. Treat commands as one-shot by default and exit after runMain returns, and have runServer declare itself long-running. That polarity is the safer one: a server that forgets to declare itself exits immediately and is noticed at once, whereas a one-shot command that forgets to exit hangs silently, which is the bug being fixed.
